# MoonPage

> MoonPage is a mobile app (iOS and Android) of original, illustrated bedtime stories for children ages 2 and up. Each story can be read by a professional narrator or recorded in a parent's own voice. No account or login is required, and the app has no ads and no third-party tracking.

MoonPage is made by EchoRealm. It's a parent-directed app: a parent or guardian downloads it and reads or plays stories together with their child. New original stories are added on an ongoing basis, each built around a gentle theme such as kindness, courage, curiosity, cozy bedtime, or lullaby-style sleepy tales.

Pricing: some stories are free with no account needed. Full access to the story library requires MoonPage Premium, a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription billed through the Apple App Store or Google Play.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Audience: children ages 2+, used together with a parent or guardian
- Keywords parents use: bedtime stories, cozy tales, lullaby stories, toddlers, preschool, picture books, read aloud, narration, sleepy stories
- Price: MoonPage Premium subscription (monthly or yearly); free stories to start
- No account, login, ads, or third-party tracking
- Distinctive feature: parents can record their own voice as story narration; recordings stay on-device
- Contact: moonpageapp@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/moonpageapp/
